campaign: Complete integrated platform validation, then transfer validated audio.cpp behavior into reusable audio primitives and composable ingest-train-evaluate-serve recipes
doctrine: Operator override (2026-09-04): work and commit only in overgo_audiocpp; do not push. After each completed audio commit, prepare and gate a first-parent-target merge of current master, review master's plan for compatible platform direction, and update affected remaining audio rows before dispatching the next audio step. Master's plan informs integration but does not replace this audio campaign. Each downloaded reference is a pinned behavioral oracle, never a linked runtime or permanent product dependency. Granite Speech 5.0 470M TurboCTC is the first offline ASR oracle; Nemotron 3.5 ASR native Safetensors is the second, streaming oracle; its incompatible Q8 GGUF remains explicitly rejected. FireRedVAD supplies segmentation evidence. Reuse internal/audiodsp, safetensors, tokenizer, hostmath/tensor, modelrecipe, capabilityruntime, dataset, evaluation, trainingprogram and trainingworkflow before adding owners. Shared execution means operation-named concrete components, even with one recipe consumer, not a new general-purpose graph engine. Model identity, tensor names, geometry, padding, normalization, weight sharing and composition belong in artifact/recipe declarations; no model-family dispatch in mathematical execution. Implement only demonstrated semantic gaps and bind each to a real recipe consumer in the same slice. Preserve one forward implementation for inference and training; checkpoint, optimizer, scheduler, resource and persistence ownership stay with the existing platform. First prove the complete processor tensor and layer/logit/token/transcript parity, then admitted offline recipe execution and early WER/CER/resource measurements. Dataset preparation and VAD depend on decoded-audio contracts and their own oracles, not on a completed recognizer. Reuse existing typed results and stored prediction evidence across consumers; performance repetitions still execute the actual recipe. Capability acceptance uses one exact integration entry point with mandatory subchecks, not a broad pattern that can match only a fraction of the promised tests. Static DSP parity is not ASR parity, and transport chunking is not native streaming. The first train-evaluate-publish-serve proof is CPU-only with an identity-initialized linear adapter on final hidden features, a frozen base, and exact stop and resume preserving optimizer, random, scheduler and data-stream state. It includes VAD composition, a pre/post WER bracket, bounded resource measurements and complete OvergoDB lineage, but does not wait for full-encoder gradients, streaming ASR, another architecture, voice expansion or CUDA. Full-encoder training, second-architecture/native streaming, alignment, diarization, voice and generative audio remain open capabilities, not discarded scope. CPU is the numerical authority; CUDA follows measured bottlenecks through kernels/manifest.json. While GPU capacity is occupied, execute eligible CPU work; commit gates may use the GPU when their derived scope requires it. Unsupported or unavailable device execution is never passing evidence. Admission decodes actual samples and quarantines policy-invalid, silent, near-silent, corrupt, clipped or non-finite records. Reference text is isolated from prediction. Pinned LibriSpeech clean is the initial positive corpus. The historically silent AMI materialization remains quarantined until exact source/transformation identity is established; the non-silent original source does not clear it. The historical audio inspection batch-key finding remains open until canonical replay is repaired and verified; isolated-store success is not repair. Use one source-bound golden corpus, independent boundary traces and explicit tolerances across inference, evaluation and training. Reject unsupported behavior rather than silently approximating it. Preserve tied weights, cancellation, memory bounds, deterministic splits, restart state and failure denominators. Measure numerical error, allocations, wall time and host memory before claiming simplification or speed; direct DFT remains a reference, not FFT performance. Prefer caller-owned buffers and single-clip synchronous execution until batching or concurrency removes measured cost. Do not add a second loader, registry, scheduler, dataset cache, optimizer, checkpoint format, service or verifier framework. Each capability extends an existing owner with concrete operations; similarly named but semantically incompatible APIs are not reused by fabricating inputs. Retain broad platform benchmarks and recovery drills after the audio proof; they do not gate first CPU capability. Findings outside the audio scope are recorded without expanding it.

steps.title: Train one identity-initialized hidden-feature projection with shared CTC loss and the base model frozen
steps.rationale: Use one square linear adapter on the final encoder hidden features, before the existing frozen CTC projection. Derive its width from the loaded hidden tensor and initialize it to identity, with no bias or additional activation required for the first proof. Reuse hostmath linear forward, LinearBackwardInput through the frozen final projection, and LinearWeightGradient for adapter updates; do not retain an encoder backward trace. The mutable matrix is hidden-width squared, not vocabulary-size squared. Bind CTC to trainingprogram and the existing optimizer, parameter-selection and checkpoint owners; include weights, gradients, optimizer workspace and forward buffers in the memory admission. Independently verify identity-logit preservation, CTC loss/gradients, repeated labels, blanks, lengths, impossible-alignment policy and unchanged base bytes. Preserve the shared final/intermediate projection; never untie it or update feedback weights under a frozen-base claim. Existing gated per-layer adapters and two-model bridge fitting have different semantics; do not fabricate side inputs or a second model to force reuse. Store base, adapter, placement and recipe identities. If held-out WER does not improve, report the result and use the planned internal/full-encoder training path rather than adding an unplanned adapter stack.

steps.title: Execute the pinned benchmark set with raw-completion anchors and template-aware answer scoring; for every chat-template choice suite prove one rendered case, print the first answer beside its candidates, and refuse an unrenderable or all-unmatched protocol; then report per-protocol committed scores, sourced references, throughput, commit identity, wall time, and missing evidence
steps.rationale: evaluate -all derives models and suites from the store, orders servable models smallest-first, enforces the six-hour total budget with per-remaining-model slices, and reports geometrically spaced per-suite progress with running score and timing. Evaluation plans bind prompting protocol so unlike passes cannot overwrite one identity. The raw-completion MMLU anchor remains comparable with lm-eval. Master d75d3554 completed the generated-letter protocol by parsing chat-template control tokens as special tokens and recognizing end-of-generation markers by token name; cc4485a0 records the corrected MMLU comparison. Master c36e5b70 renders BBH, MuSR and other text candidates as lettered options while leaving existing letter candidates direct; 4a642032 refuses an unrenderable suite at plan time, prints the first generated answer and its candidates, and stops after an all-unmatched eight-case probe instead of recording zero. Master 03f08dd2 drops instantiated CUDA graph execs whenever captured device memory is released; complete Qwen3.5 4B and 9B chat-template passes must cross the prior BBH failure windows and therefore serve as the long-run replay-safety proof as well as quality measurements. Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-12B and Qwen3.8-27B now score near or above their raw anchors, while base, long-thinking and explanation-prone models retain bounded unmatched counts. The generated report derives all servable models and their latest per-protocol evidence from OvergoDB, prints missing measurements, and keeps published references as sourced declarations. The remaining broad suite includes MMLU and MMLU-Pro, TruthfulQA, IFEval, sequence likelihood or perplexity, retrieval quality, and applicable multimodal evaluation.
